messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - continuous-batch service high tail-latency in eu-west-1 (alert: cb_tail_99.9 > 2.5s) | runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cb-latency
ashwin: acked — I'm oncall. grabbing initial metrics and rolling logs now.
tori: i'm watching dashboards, seeing a sharp jump starting ~1767004200. QPS steady, but queueing depth + microbatch sizes climb. :thinking_face:
mike: can you paste the top series? I'm on the other incident but can jump in if needed.
ashwin: past-minute snapshot:
```
cb.queue_depth (p95): 180 -> 720
cb.microbatch_size (p95): 8 -> 48
cb.tail_latency_99.9: 0.9s -> 3.1s
kvcache.evictions/s: 12 -> 280
kvcache.kv_retries/s: 0.2 -> 26
```
jin: holy — evictions spiking suggests cache churn. probably prefetch/pinning loop interacting with batch coalescing. seeing repeating key churn traces in logs.
ashwin: grep from a worker log (truncated):
```
2026-05-11T14:45:02Z worker-42 INFO kvcache: evict key shard=eu-west-1:prompt:abcd123, live_refs=0, est_size=1.2MB
2026-05-11T14:45:02Z worker-42 DEBUG prefetch: requeue key shard=eu-west-1:prompt:abcd123 reason=missing-when-prefetch
2026-05-11T14:45:02Z worker-42 WARN batch: microbatch grew to 64 due to backpressure from queue
```
tori: looks like repeated evict->prefetch cycle for a hot key set; continuous batching is amplifying by creating large microbatches, which then blow the KV window and cause mass evictions.
mike: customer impact? any 5xxs?
ashwin: quick APICheck: enterprise-tenant "AcmeGames" saw ~18 min window with 5xx rate up from 0.03% -> 2.1% on read/stream endpoints. cs-esc notified.
cs-esc: noted. I'll open a P1 support ticket for AcmeGames and attach timeline once you confirm mitigation.
jin: mitigation idea — reduce batch coalescing and microbatch cap so we stop forming giant microbatches that thrash the KV cache. also increase KV prefetch throttle to avoid aggressive re-requests.
ashwin: agreed. proposing rapid config change:
```
# previous: cb.batch_coalesce_ms=25 cb.microbatch_target=48 cb.prefetch_parallelism=128
rbctl set pool continuous-batch \ 
  --set cb.batch_coalesce_ms=6 \ 
  --set cb.microbatch_target=16 \ 
  --set cb.prefetch_parallelism=32
```
mike: that should reduce per-microbatch pressure and dampen churn. risk: small increase in token-latency due to less coalescing, but better tail behavior. good trade for customer impact.
devops-bot: starting config rollout to eu-west-1 canary (instances: cb-canary-1..3). watch for failures.
ashwin: rolling to canary. running `curl -sS https://metrics/api/query?series=cb.tail_latency_99.9&series=cb.microbatch_size` to watch.
(6m later)
devops-bot: canary rollout complete. no crashes reported.
tori: metrics update:
```
cb.microbatch_size (p95) -> 18
cb.queue_depth (p95) -> 210
cb.tail_latency_99.9 -> 1.1s
kvcache.evictions/s -> 35
kvcache.kv_retries/s -> 2.2
```
jin: nice — tail improved ~65%. prefetch retries dropped too.
cs-esc: AcmeGames ticket updated: incident window 14:44 - 15:02, mitigation deployed 14:51, customer-facing note queued.
mike: recommend push to region after brief observation window (10m) and immediate patch to stable config once confirmed. also add a short-lived feature-flag to revert easily.
ashwin: starting region rollout to remaining eu-west pool. will keep micro-rollout steps: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 2m soak each.
(rollout logs)
devops-bot: 5% -> 25% -> 100% complete. no service-level exceptions.
ashwin: post-rollout numbers holding. monitoring continues. preparing pager handoff notes.
tori: quick root-cause summary for blameless follow-up: continuous batching coalesce window + high prefetch parallelism created pathological amplification with hot-key churn. at sustained high concurrency microbatches ballooned, evicting hot kv keys, causing reactive prefetch storms and additional latency.
jin: add to RC: workload pattern was many concurrent short sequences (low token length) with overlapping hot prefixes — that favors small microbatches. default coalesce tried to pack them together and hurt the cache.
mike: action items:
- short: lower defaults for cb.batch_coalesce_ms & cb.microbatch_target in eu regions for next 48h (owner: infra)
- short: add guard to throttle prefetch retries per-key (owner: runtime)
- mid: telemetry: surface kv churn per-key, link to tenant requests to detect hot-key loops (owner: observability)
- mid: run canary test that simulates many short sequences with 1000 concurrent clients to validate settings (owner: eng-ml)
- long: consider adaptive coalesce based on key-hotness (owner: runtime-research)
cs-esc: AcmeGames impacted subset noted; CS will follow up, offer a compensation credit if needed.
ashwin: handing off to overnight oncall @jin. leaving runbook pointers and links. please escalate if tail rises >1.5s again.
jin: ack. added to my handoff checklist and will keep an eye through the night. leaving the rollback switch at `rbctl set pool continuous-batch --set cb.batch_coalesce_ms=25` in case of regression.
mike: thx team. will capture this thread into a short postmortem draft and sync with product/CS in morning.
incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated. severity: sev2. incident channel: #incident-1767004321.
ashwin: closing the live triage thread, moving notes to the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
